paragraphs.text: He means those who embalmed the dead and buried them.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: They were more excessive in lamenting than the faithful.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Even the infidels would have oaths carried out.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: An evil conscience is never fully at rest.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Meaning, that they who have one God should be joined in most sure love.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Who by the good success seems to remit it, and therefore it should not be revenged by me.
paragraphs.label: s

paragraphs.text: Who, even though he ruled in Egypt about eighty years, yet was joined with the church of God in faith and religion.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: He speaks this by the spirit of prophecy, exhorting his brethren to have full trust in God's promise for their deliverance.
paragraphs.label: h
